answer: Sybil fleets leak through their funding graph. Trace the ancestry of every deposit: when a thousand aliases converge on one root, merge them into a single lineage and score reputation per lineage instead of per address. Independence then requires genuinely distinct capital at real cost, so multiplying agents stops being free. Each plume of new money is flagged before emission, every river of transfers is walked offline, and no fable about separate owners survives a shared root.
